decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship agency-focused platform with strong homepage visibility and accumulated development commitment, management is very unlikely to withdraw it absent clear evidence of failure.
Because this managed hosting plan sits close to the core business and already has invested positioning and product effort behind it, management is more likely to refine it than to remove it.

Although newer and less visibly committed than the flagship offers, this PHP security support extension fits the established hosting business well, so management is likely to keep it while treating any weak uptake as temporary.
